theorems.name: Submission.dmcbrcs_cutoff_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ E : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ K → E X (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) (m + 1) ω) = X ω) ∧ (∀ (Xs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), WeaklyConvergesOn Xs X → WeaklyConvergesOn (fun j => E (Xs j)) (E X)) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (E X).mass ≤ X.mass) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) K → X ω = 0) → (E X).support ⊆ K ∧ (E X).boundary.mass ≤ X.boundary.mass) ∧ (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : IMRep U (m + 1)), R.Represents X → R.carrier ⊆ K → IsIntegerMultiplicity (E X))
